source.title: Canonical Orders and Schnyder Realizers
source.subsection: Schnyder Realizer; Equivalency of Canonical Orders and Schnyder Realizers; Lemma 3
source.reuse: algorithm description and structural lemma only; clean-room bounded profile

input.rotation_system: Simple connected maximal plane triangulation; distinct neighbors per row in the canonical-order package's face-walk successor orientation; all directed face walks are triangular. For the Chapter 650 local clockwise rule, traverse each stored row in reverse because the selected outer cycle u,v,w is counterclockwise.
input.outer_face: The directed face walk u->v->w->u is the selected outer face; roots are u,v,w in the chapter's order.
input.canonical_order: A permutation beginning u,v and ending w, validated through reverse shelling and the chapter's chord rule.

output.records: Exactly n-3 interior records; outer roots omitted.

contract.parents: T1 is the leftmost earlier neighbor on the u-to-v boundary and is rooted at u; T2 is the rightmost earlier neighbor and is rooted at v; T3 is the highest-labeled later neighbor and is rooted at w.
contract.realizer_conditions: Three parent trees each reach their named outer root; every non-outer edge occurs once across the three trees; each interior vertex obeys the chapter's clockwise run order out T1, in T2, out T3, in T1, out T2, in T3, allowing empty incoming runs after reversing the stored face-walk row.
contract.complexity: O(n^5) repeated bounded face, boundary, and parent scans for n<=8; fixed workspace 4096 bytes.
contract.profile_scope: Consumes an existing rotation system and a supplied canonical order; it outputs parent assignments only, not coordinates or an embedding.
